as_told.title: Nat Kobitz saw UFO technology at Wright-Patterson

plain: A man named Nat Kobitz is said to have been led into an underground room at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio, under heavy guard, and shown a piece of a bulkhead, a structural wall from a craft, that was bonded at the atomic level. Ross Coulthart tells it as something Kobitz described to him personally: he was "shown what he described to me as the piece of a bulkhead." Michels later repeats Coulthart's account in a different way, without the bulkhead: Kobitz, dying of cancer, said he had seen UFO technology at the base. If true, it would mean the base holds material from craft that humans did not build.
